Readiness gate PASS; sprint-status.yaml already in sync (Story 3.2 keeps key 3-2-the-pi-adapter per the 2026-10-25 proposal). No Epic context compiled: Epics 5 and 6 have open design questions.
Epic 5
- Story 5.1a: AD-26's table lacks three calls the adapter already makes: deleteRef (contents: write, Q4 2026-10-25), the token-less bot lookup GET /users/<slug>[bot], and the token-less signed CI-log download. Readings: (a) AD-26 gains them as built, with a no-token row for public reads and signed downloads; (b) they move under a listed permission with the installation token, so the no-token row stays join-only (the bot lookup then uses the installation budget, not 60/h per IP).
Epic 6
- Story 6.3: xarabot tui goes over ssh when XARABOT_HOST is set, but the spine makes XARABOT_HOST host-layer config, so the host may set it too (6.2 gives status an explicit --host flag instead). Readings: (a) set means always ssh, so the host must leave it unset or the TUI ssh-es to itself; (b) local whenever this machine has the lanes (host.yaml present), ssh only otherwise; (c) a --host flag, as for status.
- Story 6.4: merged Stories from the journals: a Story merged after reconcile enqueues it (every PR here, owner_approval_paths **) gets a merged journal record only if a builder's sweep marks it before reconcile does, timed at the sweep and under that lane's agent. Readings: (a) count story: journal records with state merged (misses or misattributes those); (b) count Stories whose PR merged in the window, by merge time, from the forge.
- Story 6.4: hours when every lane is waiting-on-maintainer: the coordinator runs reconcile at least every 10 minutes, and an idle span records only its round (seconds), not the wait after it. Readings: (a) builders only, each waiting span lasting until that lane's next record, excluding the exact overlap; (b) every lane including the coordinator, spans as written, which excludes almost nothing.
